Automated Redemption Rule 9 LOGICS

6. LOCK

  • Goal Linked funds are locked: during restructuring there is no addition or subtraction of these funds — their rows show in red with a disabled Change (₹) field, and the rebalance engine never buys or sells them. Switch Liquidity funds remain fully editable.
Automated Switch Rule 7 LOGICS

1. SWITCH GROUP DETECTION

  • A switch group is any set of funds that the Switch DB pairs together. Pairs merge transitively — if A↔B and B↔C are both pairs, then A, B and C form a single group.
  • Matching is case-insensitive: a fund's name matches a Switch-DB entry by substring OR by sharing its first 8 characters.

2. GROUP INDICATOR ON PARENT ROW

  • When duplicate folios are collapsed into a single parent row and any child folio belongs to a switch group, the parent's Dep. Call cell shows an indigo ⇄ EXPAND badge.
  • The badge is non-editable. Clicking it expands the group so per-folio Dep. Call inputs become available.

3. ACTIVE SUB-GROUP

  • Only funds with a Dep. Call value greater than 0 ("active funds") take part in the calculation.
  • Funds with a blank Dep. Call stay frozen — their Change column is not touched. This lets you switch within a subset of folios without affecting the rest of the group.

4. LIVE STATUS CHIP

  • As soon as any value is typed, a "Sum X/100" chip appears under every Dep. Call input in the group and on the parent row(s). It reflects the live running total.
  • Colour states:
    • Amber — typing in progress, sum ≠ 100.
    • Green ✓ — sum = 100 and the switch is valid.
    • Red ✗ — sum = 100 but the switch is not valid (see Logic 5).

5. VALIDATION GATES

  • The Change column auto-fills only when all three gates pass:
    • (a) ≥ 2 active funds in the group.
    • (b) Sum of active Dep. Calls = 100% (±0.01 tolerance).
    • (c) Aggregate equity target CV > aggregate equity current CV across the active sub-group.
  • Gate (c) is the heart of the rule: a real switch only flows liquid/hybrid → equity, never the reverse. If your weights would shrink equity overall, the chip turns red "✗ Not a switch — equity would shrink" and the Change column is left untouched.

6. SIGN BY BUCKET

  • Once gates pass, the engine writes per-fund Change values with the sign forced by bucket:
    • Equity funds (Flexi / Small Cap / Banking / Healthcare) → Change is always positive (BUY).
    • Liquid funds (Debt / Hybrid / Switch Liquidity) → Change is always negative (REDEEM).
  • Magnitude per fund = (Dep. Call % ÷ 100) × Σ active CV − fund's current CV. The math runs first; the sign is force-applied afterwards.

7. PERSISTENCE & MANUAL OVERRIDE

  • Typed Dep. Call values are kept in memory and survive expand/collapse, Suggest Rebalance, investor switching, and tab navigation.
  • The Change column remains directly editable. Any manual edit to Change wins over the auto-fill. Re-typing Dep. Call values to a new 100-sum re-fires the auto-fill and replaces those manual values.
